hypotheses.justification: Split using CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero k p. In the prime case, install Fact p.Prime and use the existing proof. If p = 0, choose D = C. Since C is a finite group, Nat.card_pos gives Nat.card C > 0, so 0 does not divide its cardinality. Nat.factorization_zero_right makes the coefficient 0^0 = 1, and Subgroup.relIndex_self gives the required index. The induced-class equality then reduces to reflexivity. This also covers trivial C.
